notes.title: 🚢Global Magnates - Demo Update Announcement
notes.content:
First of all, we'd like to thank all the players who took the time to provide invaluable feedback over the past couple of weeks.



Thanks to that feedback, we're happy to announce that a major update to the Demo Version is live now!



This update includes numerous new features and improvements, which we've been able to make thanks to your support.




What We've Updated


Automatic Upgrading of Ports

Ports will now be able to automatically upgrade after reaching a certain amount of 'Capital Pool'. When an industry receives a supply of sufficient raw materials, it gradually builds up its Capital Pool. Once full, the industry will automatically upgrade. This change addresses several late-game issues, such as limited goods output when players don’t expand through acquisitions.



New "Industrial Demand" Display

The new "Industrial Demand" display panel allows you to check which goods are in demand and being exported. You can now filter by product type and industry, and choose whether to display unlocked ports, making trade route planning faster and more strategic.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/64858e828c4105ab93333c5e017a9e44e4bf37e8.gif"]

Clearer Picture

We've updated the Global Magnates Demo to support 2K and 4K resolution!



Port Cargo Allocation System

A new Port Cargo Allocation feature has been added. When a port's industry has multiple cargo flow directions (warehouses) simultaneously, the game will default to evenly distributing the produced goods to each warehouse, avoiding the previously occurred situation where local demand consumed all exported goods. If you acquire the industry, you can manually adjust the cargo diversion and decide the production attributes of the port yourself. This increases the strategic options for you to explore when planning your routes.

                                               [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/5c15a1c34ec0c109fbcefee2d808be2518e2ef81.jpg"]                            



Route Interface Information Update

You will now see detailed information about maritime vessels and current trade routes, including the goods transported between ports, current profits, and the cargo capacity of each vessel. This information helps you plan more wisely, maximize profits, and avoid empty voyages. You can use the newly added filtering function to view your routes more clearly.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/f1266d903bd92463d3f3ea36b5fb4ce4e18db48d.gif"]



Achievement System

Updated in-game Steam achievements, which await you to complete when we launch the official version!

                                   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/f92fa79d58b9b270e05c2bac7c125bcd7b9f5055.jpg"]                             




Follow-Up Plan
We plan to continuously improve the current gaming experience; add more scenario content to let you experience maritime trade in other regions, a fully free sandbox mode that opens all ports in the game to you, giving you a vast and free trading world; and the possibilities brought by mod expansion.



We can't wait for all players to experience these improvements and the official game in the future. We will announce the release date soon, but before that, you can:



👉Wishlish Here

👉Join our Discord

👉Follow us on X, BlueSky, Instagram, Threads, Facebook, and Reddit.



Additionally, please continue to share your thoughts with us before the game is released. We are happy to hear from all players, and your feedback is very important to us.

notes.title: Big Demo Update Coming Soon - Global Magnates July Dev Diary
notes.content:
Ahoy Magnates!

Welcome to the first Global Magnates Dev Diary!

First of all, a massive thank you for the incredible support you have shown so far. From the thousands of you who wishlisted and played the demo, to all the detailed feedback you shared over the past few weeks, we are truly grateful.

We have carefully read your suggestions, bug reports, and ideas. We are now excited to announce that a major update to the Demo is on the way, built around your feedback. While we will announce the exact release date soon, here is a first look at what is coming.


🆓 Play the Demo Now


And before we start, a reminder: Global Magnates' Demo is live right now! Try it out and start building your global maritime empire today:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003710/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
🚢 What’s New in the Upcoming Demo Update?
Here is a full overview of the new features and improvements coming soon. Please note that some of these may still change slightly before the update is released:


🏗️ Improved Port Interface
A brand new Industry Demand Display panel lets you quickly see which goods are in demand or being exported.

You can now filter by product type and industry, making trade route planning faster and more strategic.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/279f359d0ea0eabaa942fb80bbe0811e90885d16.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🖥️ High-Resolution Support
Support for 2K and 4K resolutions has been added, providing clearer visuals and a more immersive gameplay experience.
[hr][/hr]⚙️ Industry Output Allocation
You can now set how goods from your industries are distributed between local needs and export warehouses.
This gives you more control and allows for smarter resource management. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/ba16f6f7da7f5081178a6ea291f60bbfa91c35ef.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🏆 Steam Achievements
Complete specific tasks and reach milestones to unlock a brand-new set of achievements — a perfect way to show off your success as a Global Magnate!
[hr][/hr]🧮 Advanced Industry Fixes
We’ve fixed profit calculations for advanced industries.
Now, you’ll receive proper rewards for your upgrades and long-term investments.
[hr][/hr]🧭 Smarter Route Info
You will now see detailed information about your ships at sea and current trade routes, including:
– Goods being transported
– Route profitability
– Ship cargo capacity
These insights help you plan smarter, maximize profits, and avoid empty hauls.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/ece6cd968d2f617ad5f2df984eee55f7aac0c371.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🎓 Tutorial Experience Polished
We’ve refined the tutorial to offer smoother pacing and better-balanced objectives.
It now teaches the core mechanics more clearly and is more fun to play through.
[hr][/hr]🌍 Expanded Language Support
We’ve added full localization for: German, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, Korean, Japanese, and several other languages. More Magnates can now enjoy the game in their native language!
[hr][/hr]🧱 Sneak Peek: Sandbox Mode in the Works
While not yet in the Demo, we’re working on a fully open-ended Free Mode for full release.
You'll be able to plan routes, grow industries, build ports, and create your own shipping empire on their own accord.
[hr][/hr]📢 Final Notes
We’re very excited about what’s ahead and can’t wait for you to try out these improvements.
The new Demo update is just around the corner, and we’ll be announcing the release date very soon!

Until then:
– Share your thoughts with us 📝
– Wishlist the game if you haven’t yet ❤️
– And join our Discord to talk everything Global Magnates! 💬

– The Global Magnates Dev Team

notes.title: New Playable Demo Launches for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello Magnates!

We’re excited to announce that Global Magnates: Shipping Tycoon will be participating in the June edition of Steam Next Fest!

To let you experience the thrill of global shipping management ahead of time, our brand new playable demo is now live – download it now and start building your shipping empire:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003710/_Demo/

Since the first public demo release, we’ve received tons of valuable feedback from the community. (A heartfelt thank you to every player who played the game, shared your suggestions, and encouraged us along the way!)

Based on your feedback, we’ve fixed some common issues and further polished the overall experience. We’re thrilled to bring you this updated and improved demo version.

 What’s New in This Demo Update
 Bug Fixes
- Fixed incorrect task descriptions in the English version
- Fixed in-game time errors when switching between English and Chinese
- Fixed save file sorting issues when switching languages
- Fixed broken shortcut links in certain tasks
- Fixed various game crash bugs
- Fixed cross-language save file compatibility issues
- Fixed news display errors when loading saves
- Fixed an issue where loading certain saves prevented the game from starting
Improvements
- Loan limits now increase with the company's reputation level
- Upgrading the Technology Department now increases your tech point cap
- Added the ability to delete save files

Global Magnates: Shipping Tycoon is still in active development, and we’re looking forward to connecting with more players during Steam Next Fest.
If you enjoy this global shipping simulation from our small indie team, we invite you to try the demo and add the game to your wishlist — your support means the world to us and keeps us moving forward!

Thank you again for all the support and constructive feedback — we’ll continue improving the game to deliver a better experience.
Feel free to share your thoughts in the community discussions and let us know what you’d like to see next!

notes.title: V0.6.2 Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Magnates! 

We’ve made the following improvements and fixes in this Demo update:

1. Fixed a bug where players could not gain tech points when researching Level 1 technology during the tutorial.

Thank you for all your feedback and support — we’ll continue improving the gameplay experience!

notes.title: How to Change Language in Demo Build
notes.content:
Hello Magnates!

We are very excited to release the demo version of Global Magnates to you!

We noticed that there is some difficulty in changing the language to English. Our developers should have a fix in place by tomorrow, but in the meantime, please follow the steps below!

First, Select the option shown here
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/6c1febcdb93f0deaf52a96e04f26d6fd596b4b36.jpg

Second, choose the sub menu shown here
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/f3be0b6d0f14927607e153e5a79f9239eb751c9a.jpg

Third, use the arrows to change the game language.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/5cb4a475101eb8e7a1d99cd3a9fcf97c812b86cd.jpg

And finally, click "Confirm" to save English as the game language.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098546/9d89ab42b99c5538da20dd2c49676ffc2b75e0d5.jpg

And now you are ready to take on the Shipping Industry!

Again, we apologize for the inconvenience. This issue will be fixed soon.
